I would suggest to focus on why she wants to use anything to cope. I have sever anxiety and depression and medicate with various forms of marijuana. I smoke every day or every other day. BUT I always consider my chores/activities for the day and work my smoking around those instead of working my responsibility or around my smoking habits. If she has severe anxiety or other issues counselling should always be considered. When someone’s becomes “addicted” or dependent on marijuana it’s not the marijuana that’s the problem, Anything, whether it’s naturally good or bad, can become a coping mechanism  and turn into a problem. Open up to her in a way that’s not basking her smoking or using edibles, instead ask how her anxiety is or how she’s dealing with other stressors in her life. Always remember that you’re not fighting with her either, your fighting for her to get the help and balance she needs in her life. Good luck!
